Discover Board Game Arena Rules summary Contents 1 On Your Turn 2 Element Tokens 3 Scoring Years (Points) 4 Game End & Final Scoring 5 Co-op & Solo Mode 6 Spirit Scrolls Expansion 6.1 Setup & Overview 6.2 Claiming a Scroll 6.3 New Action: Activate Scroll 6.4 Free Action: Refreshing Scrolls On Your Turn Take 2 mandatory actions from the available options (you may choose Draw or Summon, repeating an action if desired). Discard down to 7 cards at the end of your turn. Draw: Take 1 card from the 8 face-up cards (refill immediately) or draw from the top of the deck. Summon: Placement: Place the card into an empty space or on top of a lower-rank version of the same animal (Ascending). Cost: The base cost equals the card's rank, reduced by: Each adjacent Shared Element. The difference in rank when Ascending the same animal. Payment: Pay the cost by discarding cards or tokens matching either the Element or Animal icon of the summoned card. Animal Token: Take the matching Animal Token (steal from an opponent if needed). Element Tokens Acquire an Element Token by: Playing an animal on top of a lower-rank matching animal (Ascending). Covering an existing token on a game board space. (If none remain in the supply, steal one from another player.)* Scoring Years (Points) Gain Years (points) dynamically during the game: Gaining an Animal Token: Score 1 Year per Animal Token you currently control. Ascending an Animal: When ascending an animal you already control, score 1 Year per Element Token you currently control. Game End & Final Scoring The end of the game triggers when the deck runs out or any player reaches 60 Years , finishing the current round. Final Scoring: 1 Year per remaining Element Token in your control. 1 Year per card in your hand that matches an Animal Token you control. Tiebreaker: The player controlling the current Year's animal (for 2026: the Horse ) wins ties. Co-op & Solo Mode Objective: Fully Ascend all 12 animals to Rank 5 before the deck runs out. Movement: When placing a new animal, you may move any 1 animal by 1 space to optimize adjacent element discounts. Rank 5 Animals: Once an animal reaches Rank 5, place its Animal Token on top. It is locked, cannot be moved, and acts as a barrier. Endgame Scoring: Score only at the end for animals that reached Rank 5: 1 Year per card of that animal on the board. Perfect Clear Bonus: If all 12 animals reach Rank 5, score an extra 1 Year per remaining card in the deck and face-up row. Rankings: 1–11: Beginner 12–20: Apprentice 21–28: Average 29–37: Good 38–45: Strong 46–54: Expert 55–59: Master! Spirit Scrolls Expansion Setup & Overview 5 Scroll types (one per element), each ranked Level 1 to 5. Stack scrolls by element in 5 piles: Level 5 on the bottom, Level 1 on the top. Claiming a Scroll Requirement: Summon an Animal Card matching the Scroll's element. The animal's level sets the maximum level of Scroll you can claim. Cost: Move your marker backward on the Year Track by the Scroll's level. Exchange Discount: If upgrading/replacing a Scroll of that element, reduce the Year cost by the level of the returned Scroll (active or inactive). Discard any lower-level Scrolls passed over to the box. Place the claimed Scroll in front of you on its active side. New Action: Activate Scroll Takes 1 of your 2 mandatory actions per turn. Flip an active Scroll to its inactive side to resolve its effect. The effect can only target cards/values equal to or lower than the Scroll's level. Wood: Search the discard pile to summon 1 valid Animal Card directly to the board for free (normal placement and scoring apply). Fire: Remove an animal and all its cards from the board.
